title: Noise-bent SVG line field with a pointer spring
summary: Hairline SVG field, one Perlin angle per point drifting in time, pointer push with a framerate-independent spring (.005 / .925), edge-first draw-in, still under reduced motion
variants: one merged SVG path redrawn on the shared ticker, hand-written staggered draw-in (this)
one path per line with GSAP 3.15 DrawSVGPlugin for the intro, for a handful of lines
canvas 2D polylines when the grid passes ~10k points
